We may also encounter various species of jellyfish, giant Mola Mola sunfish, sharks and possibly sea turtles. blurb: Sea Star Fishing Charters offers private group charters for sport fishing, whale watching, marine science labs, and burials at sea. They fish local kelp beds, rocky reefs, and offshore banks from Dana Point to La Jolla. The prime fishing season is April through November with various fish species available.
